title: The Tempo of the Hunt
description: The Tempo is delighted the trail was wrong about the party's speed. This isn't a threat — it's a game. Don't let it catch you. FIX 2026-07-28 (cowir-ai msg-3206): this scene's hospitality beat was gated on a 'completionist' branch key that _detect_playstyle CAN NEVER RETURN (it returns automator/grinder/exploiter/manual/balanced only), so it had never played for any player. The beat is unconditional in canon — W1 ch.4 has the Warden offer the guardhouse food with no condition attached — so it is now the default arm rather than a playstyle reward. Playstyle-specific arms (e.g. grinder) are untouched and still take precedence.

lines.speaker: Tempo
lines.text: Track me first. Find where I've been. Then we'll see if you can find where I am.

lines.speaker: Tempo
lines.text: You're faster than the trail suggested. I like it when the trail is wrong.

lines.speaker: Tempo
lines.text: Don't let me catch you. That's not a threat. That's the game.
